test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the archaeological site named Gottiprolu, which provides the evidence of an ancient period maritime trade centre, situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An archaeological survey of India (ASI) excavation in **Gottiprolu, **in the SPS Nellore district of** Andhra Pradesh, **has revealed that the region may have been a vast settlement and thriving **commercial centre more than 2,000 years ago.**
 
• The **ASI crew reported finding a life-size Vishnu sculpture**, a 2,000-year-old brick structure, and a variety of pottery-related items after completing the initial round of excavations** close to Naidupeta.**
 
• **Gottiprolu** is located on the right bank of a distributary of the **Swarnamukhi River**, 80 kilometres from Tirupati and Nellore and 17 kilometres **east of Naidupeta.**​ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **According to the ASI, **the excavation also turned up brick buildings in a variety of **shapes and sizes**, including elliptical, circular, and **rectangular ones.**
 
• A la**rge brick enclosure wall was also found**, measuring more than 75 metres in length, 3.4 metres in width on average, and approximately 2 metres in **height in a curved pattern.**
 
• **Archaeologists compared the brick sizes** to those of the Satavahana and Ikshvaku dynasties, which can be dated to the first or second century BC, after **analysing the brick sizes.**
